archetype: Burst-oriented hybrid of a keydown (hurricane-type) class and a combo class. The class doc describes her as sitting between archer and thief identity: most damage lands inside a short burst window, she has no gauge and no map summons to manage, and her kit is built around linking skills together - linking is not cosmetic, because linking reduces the cooldown of Unicorn Spike, Wrath of Enlil, Spikes Royale and the tree portion of Spirit of Elluel by 1 second per link. Weapon multiplier 1.3x and base attack speed stage 4 per Grandis Library. She brings three party debuffs with 100% uptime: 55% defense reduction from Spikes Royale (with the Armorbreak hyper), 30% party damage from Unicorn Spike, and touch-damage nullification, which the class doc says only Mercedes and Night Lord can provide consistently.

nodeGroups.note: THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING STRUCTURE FOR MERCEDES BOOST NODES, and it was re-verified from two independent sources on 2026-09-12. Boost node skill membership is FIXED, not player-chosen: maplestorywiki (GMS v270) enumerates six numbered 'Boost Node/Enhancement Core' groups, and Grandis Library (GMS v269) lists the same six groups with identical membership in its 'Skills Boosted by Each Nodes' table. Grandis additionally exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle, which is direct evidence the groupings changed at V.269. Grandis states the mechanic as: 'Each Boost Node provides a %Final Damage increase to the skills included in the node. Nodes categorized as PRIMARY and SECONDARY are recommended to be upgraded.'

tierDefinitionsPerGrandis.PRIMARY: Unlocks a 6th Job HEXA Mastery core. Highest priority.
tierDefinitionsPerGrandis.SECONDARY: Frequently used skills that do not unlock a mastery core (as of the v269 page state).

nodeGroups.tierNote: The tier labels come from Grandis Library, which credits its Boost Nodes Build to the Class Doc, so the labels are one editorial lineage. They are corroborated STRUCTURALLY rather than editorially: Grandis defines PRIMARY as 'unlocking 6th Job HEXA Mastery', and maplestorywiki's HEXA Mastery Node/Core 1-4 memberships map 1:1 onto boost node groups 1-4, so the PRIMARY assignment on groups 1 and 2 is mechanically checkable and checks out. The earlier file recorded group 2's tier as 'PRIMARY or SECONDARY - label unverified'; the 2026-09-12 re-read returned PRIMARY, and the mastery-core mapping supports PRIMARY. Ambiguity resolved.

priorityOrdering.reason: The class doc explicitly declines to rank boost node combinations ('While the combinations in which you boost your skills ultimately don't matter...'), and its one numbered NODE LEVELING PRIORITY list is an embedded image that the document's text export does not carry - re-checked 2026-09-12, still unreadable. The ONLY ranking any source actually states is Grandis Library's PRIMARY > SECONDARY > OTHER tiering of the six fixed node groups, which is recorded in vMatrix.nodeGroups. The entries in vMatrix.priority below therefore carry rank: null and their array position must NOT be read as a priority order.

priority.node: All nine of Mercedes' used skills must end up boosted - the partition matters far less than the coverage
priority.why: Class doc, verbatim: 'While the combinations in which you boost your skills ultimately don't matter, for a low level Mercedes the right node combination can make managing nodes easier until later levels. Ultimately, you will need to boost all the above skills in order to level your sixth job.' And: 'your nodes will work out as long as all 9 skills are eventually maxed.' Corroborated independently in count: mastermysty's cross-class reference names exactly nine Mercedes skills across its three trios (Unicorn Spike, Ishtar's Ring, Stunning Strikes, Leaf Tornado, Spikes Royale, Wrath of Enlil, Rising Rush, Lightning Edge, Elemental Knights). The '6th job' half of the claim is now concrete rather than vague: maplestorywiki shows boost node groups 1-4 map 1:1 onto HEXA Mastery Cores 1-4.

Grandis Library tiers node group 1 PRIMARY, re-read 2026-09-12. It is the skill you fall back to when comboing is unsafe - the class doc's Darknell section says 'Learning to use Ishtar's Ring instead of forcing combos even when it seems safe will save you a lot of lives.' Three of the five hyper passive points go into Ishtar's Ring passives (Reinforce, Guardbreak, Boss Rush), and the class doc says those hypers also apply to Ishtar's Mark, the 6th job mark mechanic. mastermysty puts Ishtar's Ring in the bossing trio in both of the setups it lists.

innerAbility.notes: Every claim in this section was re-read against the class doc's full plain-text export on 2026-09-12 and matches verbatim. This is the best-sourced of the five endgame sections in terms of fidelity, and simultaneously the weakest in terms of independence: with the single exception of Grandis' training preset, all of it traces to one document.

gearingNotes: CRIT RATE BEHAVES DIFFERENTLY ON THIS CLASS. Vicious Shot (Bowman shared V skill, master level 30) allows Critical Rate to exceed 100% and turns crit rate into crit damage for its duration - its formula reads 'Critical Damage to increase by {20+x}% of Critical Rate', i.e. 21% at Lv.1 rising to 50% at Lv.30 - and most of Mercedes' damage is dealt inside that window. Crit rate therefore keeps scaling past the point where it would be dead weight on other classes, which is why the class doc refuses to drop the inner ability crit rate line and why it warns that Kinesis' Judgment link underperforms on Vicious Shot. ATTACK SPEED: Mercedes caps at 10 without any inner ability - class doc, verbatim: 'Base (4), Elven Grace (5), Booster (7), Ignis (8), DSI and Green Pot (10).' Ignis Roar gives +1 attack speed from a single stack and breaks the soft cap; the doc says it is a large final damage boost and stacks should never be allowed to drop. Note that the two skills carrying the burst, Ishtar's Ring and Irkalla's Wrath, are keydown skills unaffected by attack speed - the investment is for combo speed, safety and smoother grinding rotations. IED: because Spikes Royale with the Armorbreak hyper applies a 55% defense reduction, the doc says Mercedes needs no IED lines on weapon/secondary/emblem and that visual IED as low as 93% is acceptable in the mid game. WSE: the doc's current ideal is 8 lines attack / 1 line boss damage / 0 IED, with the boss line preferably on the secondary (the weapon gives 1% more attack per line than the secondary due to its level, while boss lines are equal on both), or 7/2/0; it advises running a calculator because the answer is character-specific, and notes the gap between 8/1/0 and 7/2/0 is larger on non-Reboot servers where bonus potential attack% exists. Best secondary per the doc is the Princess No secondary. If you do end up with IED lines, the doc says drop IED from the Legion artifact in favour of boss damage, then DEX or crit rate. COOLDOWN HAT: breakpoints are -2 and -5 seconds and nothing in between does anything - class doc, verbatim: 'Our breakpoints are -2 seconds and -5 seconds. Any other amount of cooldown reduction is useless.' The doc recommends a -2 second hat for both mains and bossing mules and says a stat hat 'has become somewhat obsolete over the sixth job patches'; -5 seconds it calls 'unrealistic for Reboot/Heroic'. The more cooldown reduction you carry, the more you must actively combo to come out ahead. LEGION ARTIFACT: the doc's six most important stats are Critical Rate 20%, Boss Damage 15%, Damage 15%, All Stats 150, Critical Damage 4%, Ignore Enemy Defense 20%.

commonMistakes.mistake: Playing Mercedes as a pure keydown class - holding Ishtar's Ring and never linking skills
commonMistakes.detail: The class doc calls this the least damage possible short of not attacking, and sets a minimum standard of using the linked skills off cooldown. It is also a node problem: linking is what reduces the cooldowns of Unicorn Spike, Wrath of Enlil, Spikes Royale and the Spirit of Elluel tree by 1 second each time.

commonMistakes.mistake: Over-committing to combos when the safe play was to reposition
commonMistakes.detail: The doc says learning when not to combo is harder than learning the combos, and names over-committing as a mistake experienced Mercedes players still make. Half-comboing or falling back to Ishtar's Ring is explicitly fine - on Darknell the doc writes 'Learning to use Ishtar's Ring instead of forcing combos even when it seems safe will save you a lot of lives.'

commonMistakes.mistake: Letting Ignis Roar stacks fall off
commonMistakes.detail: A single stack is worth +1 attack speed past the soft cap and the skill is a large final damage boost; the doc says it should never be dropped. Note that cancelling Gust Dive with Leaf Tornado does not add a stack.

commonMistakes.mistake: Not keeping the Unicorn Spike and Spikes Royale debuffs applied before and during burst
commonMistakes.detail: Unicorn Spike is 30% party damage and Spikes Royale is 55% defense reduction, both 100% uptime debuffs; the doc's burst instruction is to have both applied (plus Ishtar's Mark post-6th-job) before bursting.

commonMistakes.mistake: Cancelling Gust Dive with Leaf Tornado in a combo where Stunning Strikes was supposed to link out of it
commonMistakes.detail: The Leaf Tornado cancel is the standard way to kill Gust Dive's endlag, but using it where the combo wanted a Stunning Strikes link costs you the 1 second cooldown reduction from that link.

commonMistakes.mistake: Sinking nodestones into boost node groups 5 and 6 before groups 1-4
commonMistakes.detail: CORRECTED 2026-09-12. This entry previously read 'Spending nodestones boosting Swift Dual Shot, Piercing Storm or Parting Shot / None of the three are used after their job advancements' and cited the class doc. The class doc says no such thing - its full text contains zero occurrences of 'Swift Dual Shot' and 'Piercing Storm' and one unrelated occurrence of 'Parting Shot'. What is actually sourced: Grandis Library tiers node group 5 (Lightning Edge, Swift Dual Shot, Piercing Storm) and node group 6 (Rising Rush, Parting Shot, Aerial Barrage, Rolling Moonsault) as OTHER, its lowest tier, and says only PRIMARY and SECONDARY nodes are recommended to be upgraded. Groups 1-4 are what unlock the four HEXA Mastery cores per maplestorywiki.

skillNameReference.note: ANTI-FABRICATION ALLOWLIST. Validated against maplestorywiki.net/w/Mercedes/Skills (raw wikitext, GMS v270 stamp on the skill infoboxes) plus the linked pages for shared skills. Use these spellings; do not emit a Mercedes skill name that is not here. The 2026-09-12 pass added the elfBasics, firstJob and sharedVSkills sections, which were missing and which the file's own prose was already relying on (Elven Grace, Swift Dual Shot, Vicious Shot, Guided Arrow) - the allowlist existed but did not cover the names actually in use.
hexaMasterySkills: HEXA Wrath of Enlil: Spirit Enchant

rejectedAliases.Ishtar's Brand: Not a game string. Class-doc and community spelling of Ishtar's Mark. Accept as a search alias; never emit.
rejectedAliases.Ishtar Brand: Not a game string. The class doc's other spelling of Ishtar's Mark. Accept as a search alias; never emit.
rejectedAliases.Leap Tornado: Not a game string. Grandis Library and the class doc's prose both use it; maplestorywiki uses 'Leaf Tornado' in all 76 occurrences. Accept as a search alias; never emit.
rejectedAliases.Spirit Enhance: Not a game string. The class doc's spelling of 'Spirit Enchant'. Accept as a search alias; never emit.

sources.what: The Mercedes class guide maintained out of the Mercedes Discord. Credits read: Akki (Akki, EU Reboot) main author, contactable on discord as akkimyl; Jason (gtrpro, NA Reboot) co-author/editor and main author of the training section; Bread (Sekki, Bera) co-author/editor and main author of the bossing section; Ian (Mulch, Scania) editor. Re-read in full on 2026-09-12 via the document's plain-text export (docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/export?format=txt, 83KB, needs a browser user agent). It is the only source with real judgement on inner ability, hyper skills, WSE, cooldown hats and gearing. Its boost node trios, node leveling priority, burst sequence table and HEXA upgrade order are all embedded images and remain unreadable.
sources.dated: 2025-06-11, self-stamped 'STARGAZER/NEXT PATCH' - roughly 15 months and several patches behind the v.271 target

sources.what: Grandis Library's Mercedes page: class properties, boost node groupings with priority tiers, hyper skill passive build, recommended inner ability for bossing and training, link skill, base stats from skills. NOT AN INDEPENDENT SOURCE for the judgement fields - its own credits line reads 'Inner Ability + Hyper Passive Build + Boost Nodes Build: Class Doc'. It IS an independent factual check on boost node group membership, which is game data and matched maplestorywiki exactly on re-check. Its tier definitions, quoted: PRIMARY unlocks 6th Job HEXA Mastery, SECONDARY is frequently used skills that do not unlock mastery, OTHER is lowest priority; 'Each Boost Node provides a %Final Damage increase to the skills included in the node. Nodes categorized as PRIMARY and SECONDARY are recommended to be upgraded.' Has no HEXA section.
sources.dated: Site footer stamp GMS Ver. 269 [Ride the Lightning Update] - two patches behind v.271; the page also exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle, evidence that node groupings changed at v269

sources.what: mastermysty's cross-class boost node trio reference. Re-verified 2026-09-12 - the page carries real text skill names alongside its icons, so the trios recorded here are read, not inferred from image filenames. Gives Mercedes a 'General' setup (Bossing: Unicorn Spike / Ishtar's Ring / Stunning Strikes; Bossing + Mobbing: Leaf Tornado / Spikes Royale / Wrath of Enlil; Supplimentary: Rising Rush / Lightning Edge / Elemental Knights) and a 'Some Prefer This' alternative. SUPERSEDED: none of these partitions is possible under the six fixed boost node groups that maplestorywiki v270 and Grandis v269 both list.
sources.dated: Page states 'Last update: November 21st, 2024' - post-6th-job but predates the V.269 boost node change and every 2025-2026 balance pass

sources.what: Skill name and value reference: full skill lists by job tier including Elf Basics and 1st job, hyper skills with unlock levels, class-specific V skills, the six numbered V Enhancement / Boost Node groups, HEXA skills split into Mastery cores 1-4 and HEXA Enhancements, and the Ishtar's Mark mechanic text. Zero judgement - used strictly as the anti-fabrication allowlist and as the independent factual check on node and mastery core structure. Returns 403 to plain fetching; the raw wikitext is readable at ?action=raw with a normal browser user agent.

Bowman shared V skill page. Active, max level 30, formula 'Allows Critical Rate to exceed 100% and Critical Damage to increase by {20+x}% of Critical Rate' - i.e. 21% at Lv.1, 50% at Lv.30. Lists Mercedes among its classes. This is the mechanical basis for the crit-rate argument in gearingNotes and hyperStats.notes.
Confirms the Bowman shared V skill set is exactly Guided Arrow and Vicious Shot, which is what licenses both names into the allowlist.

Link skill page - per-level EXP values for both the link version and Mercedes' own version, and the confirmation that Mercedes' level 3 copy also grants +5% Damage. Note 'Elven Blessing' (link) is a different skill from 'Elvish Blessing' (hyper active).

The Korean-built HEXA core order tool the class doc defers to for Mercedes' 6th job upgrade order. It computes an order per character preset rather than publishing a class list, and it is KMS-balance - which is precisely why no fixed Mercedes HEXA order exists in public.

Mercedes class Discord, linked from Grandis Library and home of the class doc. Not machine-readable. Given the doc is 15 months old and its trio, leveling-priority, burst-sequence and HEXA-order tables are all images, this is where those four gaps would have to be closed.

REJECTED, listed so it is not rediscovered as a source. Its changelog's only entry is '04/02 2021 - First update'. Verified to contain no 6th job or HEXA content, no node priority and no hyper stat allocation, and its hyper skill list differs from the class doc's. Pre-6th-job content that ranks well for Mercedes queries.

conflicts.topic: Spelling of the 3rd job tornado skill
positions: maplestorywiki.net spells it 'Leaf Tornado' in all 76 occurrences on the Mercedes skill page (GMS v270 stamp), and the class doc's own section heading for the skill also reads LEAF TORNADO
Grandis Library spells it 'Leap Tornado' in its node table, and the class doc's prose uses 'Leap Tornado' far more often than 'Leaf Tornado'
conflicts.resolution: Treat 'Leaf Tornado' as canonical - it is the in-game string per the skill table, which is the only source here with no judgement attached. 'Leap Tornado' is logged in skillNameReference.rejectedAliases as a search alias.

conflicts.topic: Name of the 6th job mark mechanic
positions: maplestorywiki (GMS v270) uses 'Ishtar's Mark' in 11 places, including the HEXA Ishtar's Ring description ('the enemy is branded with Ishtar's Mark') and the Unfading Glory formula. 'Ishtar's Brand' appears 0 times as a skill or mechanic name.
The class doc uses both 'Ishtar Brand' (burst rotation section) and 'Ishtar's Brand' (hyper skills section).
conflicts.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-09-12 in favour of 'Ishtar's Mark'. It is the in-game string, and the product compares against what a player sees in their own client, so emitting a name that returns nothing in game would send players hunting for something that does not exist. All four load-bearing uses in this file were rewritten. Both doc spellings are logged as rejected aliases.

positions: mastermysty (2024-11-21) gives two three-trio partitions, both of which mix skills across what are now separate fixed node groups
maplestorywiki (v270) and Grandis Library (v269) independently enumerate six FIXED boost node groups with identical membership; Grandis exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle
The class doc's own recommended trios are still images and its position is still unknown; its readable text says the partition ultimately does not matter and that all nine skills end up maxed
conflicts.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-09-12 in favour of the six fixed node groups, which two independent sources agree on exactly. mastermysty's trios were demoted to vMatrix.supersededPreV269Trios with useForGuidance false - they are accurately transcribed but describe a system that no longer exists. This also makes the class doc's unreadable trio images moot for guidance, though its node LEVELING priority image is still a real gap.

conflicts.topic: Tier label on boost node group 2 (Leaf Tornado / Spikes Royale / Wrath of Enlil)
positions: An earlier read of Grandis Library returned SECONDARY for this group
The 2026-09-12 read of Grandis Library returned PRIMARY
conflicts.resolution: RESOLVED as PRIMARY. Beyond the re-read, it is mechanically checkable: Grandis defines PRIMARY as the tier that unlocks a 6th Job HEXA Mastery, and maplestorywiki shows boost node group 2's membership is exactly HEXA Mastery Core 2's membership. The 'label unverified' hedge has been removed.

positions: Class doc: 'Spikes Royale - Temper Link (Recommended) OR Water Shield - True Immunity 1', plus Water Shield - Reinforce as a temporary under-200 survivability pick
Grandis Library: adds Spikes Royale - Reinforce to the same slot's option list
conflicts.resolution: Recorded, not resolved. Grandis is downstream of the doc by its own credits and should not be adding options of its own. All four options are listed in hyperSkills.flexPick with optionsAreRanked false, and the doc's recommendation is stated separately so a reader can see which one actually has an opinion behind it.

conflicts.topic: Which skill is the 6th job Origin skill
positions: maplestorywiki labels 'Skill Node/Core 1 (Origin): Unfading Glory' and 'Skill Node/Core 2 (Ascent): Primeval Spirits', and lists Irkalla's Wrath under Class-Specific V Skills
An early automated read of the class doc reported Irkalla's Wrath as the Origin skill
conflicts.resolution: Resolved in favour of Unfading Glory as Origin and Irkalla's Wrath as a 5th job V skill. maplestorywiki labels it explicitly, and the doc's burst sequence ('use Irkalla's Wrath, followed by Unfading Glory after sixth job') is only coherent that way. Recorded because the wrong version appeared in an intermediate extraction and could resurface.

gaps: HEXA investment order: still no public source. The class doc deliberately defers to a per-character tool (maplescouter) and its indicative chart is an image. hexa.order stays null. This is the single biggest hole and it is exactly the thing the product is meant to answer.
Hyper stat allocation: no source found. The string 'hyper stat' appears zero times in the class doc. hyperStats.priority stays null.

Node LEVELING priority (which node group to pour levels into first, beyond Grandis' three coarse tiers): the class doc's numbered list is an image. OCR or a human read of the doc would close this in one pass.
The class doc's burst SEQUENCE table is also an image; only the prose framing of the burst is sourced.
Currency: the class doc is 2025-06-11 against a v.271 target, Grandis is v269 and maplestorywiki is v270. Nothing Mercedes-specific dated 2026 was reachable.

Reddit was not reachable in this environment, so r/Maplestory Mercedes threads are unexamined. The Mercedes Discord (discord.gg/tJWfMrdFBJ) is unread. The class doc references a video guide by Hexy titled 'The ULTIMATE Mercedes Guide' which the doc itself calls somewhat outdated - an unfollowed lead.

Independence: for JUDGEMENT claims (what to pick, in what order) Mercedes has effectively ONE independent source, the class doc - Grandis Library is downstream of it by its own credits, and mastermysty is superseded. The brief's three-independent-sources 'strong' bar is met by NO endgame claim in this file, and nothing is labelled strong. The independent corroboration that does exist (maplestorywiki) is factual only: node group and mastery core structure, skill names, unlock levels, skill formulas.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
contest.resolutionMethod: Every disputed endgame claim was re-checked against the page it already cited, not against new sources. The class doc was re-read in full via its plain-text export; maplestorywiki was re-read as raw wikitext (?action=raw with a browser user agent, which bypasses the 403 that plain fetching gets); Grandis Library and mastermysty were re-fetched. Three additional citation and shape defects that the contest pass did not catch were found and fixed in the process.

resolved.defect: 'Ishtar's Brand' does not exist as a game string; maplestorywiki v270 calls it Ishtar's Mark. Used in 4 load-bearing places.
resolved.what: Re-checked the cited page. maplestorywiki's raw wikitext contains 'Ishtar's Mark' 11 times and 'Ishtar's Brand' 0 times; the mark is created by HEXA Ishtar's Ring ('the enemy is branded with Ishtar's Mark') and is referenced in the Unfading Glory and HEXA Wrath of Enlil formulas. The contest pass was right about the game string but slightly wrong about the doc: the class doc uses BOTH 'Ishtar Brand' (burst section) and 'Ishtar's Brand' (hyper skills section, with a curly apostrophe, which is why a naive grep missed it). All four uses rewritten to 'Ishtar's Mark'; both doc spellings logged in skillNameReference.rejectedAliases as search-only aliases; a conflicts entry added so this cannot silently revert.

resolved.defect: Allowlist not enforced: the file emits Vicious Shot, Elven Grace and Swift Dual Shot, none of which appear in skillNameReference, which has no 1st job section at all.
resolved.scope: in-scope in part (vMatrix and hyperStats.notes rely on these names)
resolved.what: All three verified real on maplestorywiki and the allowlist repaired rather than the prose. Elven Grace is an Elf Basics (0th job) skill; Swift Dual Shot is 1st job; Vicious Shot is a Bowman shared V skill (max level 30, 'Critical Damage to increase by {20+x}% of Critical Rate' = 21% at Lv.1 and 50% at Lv.30, exactly as gearingNotes states). Added elfBasics, firstJob and sharedVSkills sections plus hexaMasterySkills, hexaEnhancements, mechanicNames and rejectedAliases. The allowlist now covers every Mercedes name the file emits.

resolved.defect: No other fabrication found (the contest pass's own clearance, recorded in its defects array).
resolved.what: Independently re-verified against maplestorywiki raw wikitext on 2026-09-12: all 16 node skill names; the six boost node groups; all 12 HEXA mastery skill names and their split across Mastery Cores 1-4; all 4 HEXA Enhancement cores at Level Requirement 260; Unfading Glory labelled Origin and Primeval Spirits labelled Ascent; all 12 hyper skill names with unlock levels, including the distinct 'Elvish Blessing' (hyper active, Lv.140) vs 'Elven Blessing' (link skill); and Staggering Strikes vs Stunning Strikes as two separate 4th/3rd job skills. The null hyperStats.priority and null hexa.order remain correct restraint and stay null.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during resolution - CITATION INVERSION. vMatrix.priority[5] read 'Do not boost Swift Dual Shot, Piercing Storm or Parting Shot' and attributed it to the class doc: 'The class doc says these three are not used after their job advancements and there is no reason to boost them.'
resolved.what: The class doc's full 83KB text export contains ZERO occurrences of 'Swift Dual Shot', ZERO of 'Piercing Storm', and exactly one of 'Parting Shot', in an unrelated combo note ('You can use the normal attack key instead of this skill after Rising Rush, and Parting Shot will be used'). The class doc attribution was invented and has been deleted. The claim was rewritten to what Grandis actually supports - node groups 5 and 6 are its OTHER, lowest tier - and narrowed to the node group, because the node is the unit you upgrade and node 5 also contains Lightning Edge, which IS used. The same bad citation in commonMistakes was fixed identically.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during resolution - SUPERSEDED DATA SHIPPED AS GUIDANCE. vMatrix.trios shipped mastermysty's two three-trio partitions as the file's trio recommendation.
resolved.what: mastermysty's content was verified accurate to its source, role labels included. But maplestorywiki (v270) and Grandis Library (v269) independently enumerate six boost node groups with identical FIXED membership, and neither of mastermysty's partitions is constructible from them - e.g. mastermysty pairs Ishtar's Ring with Unicorn Spike and Stunning Strikes, while Ishtar's Ring sits alone in group 1. mastermysty is stamped 2024-11-21 and Grandis exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle. The block was renamed to vMatrix.supersededPreV269Trios with useForGuidance false and a warning, so downstream code reading 'trios' finds nothing and no player is handed an impossible build. A new vMatrix.nodeGroups section carries the two-source-verified current structure instead.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during resolution - SHAPE ASSERTS WHAT THE SOURCE DECLINES. vMatrix.priority was an ordered array whose own first element says the arrangement does not matter, and the class doc's only numbered node priority is an unreadable image.
resolved.what: Added vMatrix.priorityOrdering {ordered: false} with the reason, and rank: null on every entry, so array position asserts nothing. The only boost-node ranking now stated anywhere in the file is Grandis Library's PRIMARY > SECONDARY > OTHER tiering of the six node groups, which the source does state explicitly. The same treatment was applied to hyperSkills.passives (ordered false - all four are taken, not ranked), hyperSkills.flexPick.optionsAreRanked false, and innerAbility.alternatives (ordered false). Conversely, three arrays that ARE genuinely ordered in their source now say so with a justification: hexa.hexaStatPriority (the doc writes 'attack > main stat > boss'), innerAbility.bossing (line slots are assigned by the rolling procedure) and innerAbility.rollingOrder (the doc prints it as a numbered 1-4 list).

resolved.defect: NEW, found during resolution - UNRESOLVED HEDGE. nodeGroupsPerGrandis carried 'PRIMARY or SECONDARY - label unverified' on node group 2.
resolved.what: Re-read of Grandis returned PRIMARY, and it is now mechanically corroborated rather than just re-read: Grandis defines PRIMARY as the tier that unlocks a 6th Job HEXA Mastery, and maplestorywiki shows boost node group 2's membership (Leaf Tornado, Spikes Royale, Wrath of Enlil) is exactly HEXA Mastery Core 2's membership. Hedge removed.

contest.shipReadyScope: The five endgame sections only (vMatrix, hexa, hyperSkills, hyperStats, innerAbility). Jobs 1-4 skill builds, damage coefficients, damageLine, job tiers and rotations were out of scope for this pass and were not touched; this file carries no skillBuilds or coefficient data to begin with, so there were no out-of-scope defects to count.

writtenNote: Set true on 2026-09-12 because every claim remaining in the five endgame sections was re-read against its cited page this session and either matched, was corrected to match, or had its bad attribution deleted. hexa.order and hyperStats.priority are null, and null is a recorded gap with a sourced explanation, not an unverified claim - see hexa.notes and hyperStats.priorityNullReason. NOTHING in this file is labelled consensus 'strong': Mercedes has one independent judgement source (the class doc), Grandis Library is downstream of it by its own credits, and mastermysty is superseded, so the three-independent-source bar is met by no endgame claim. The labels are deliberately pessimistic; read them as written.
